title: Texas Roadhouse in the works next to a new 330-unit luxury apartment complex - NewsBreak
text:
By Jacob Willeford ,
11 hours ago
DINERS in a US city will soon get a Texas Roadhouse next to a massive luxury apartment complex with 330 units.
The beloved casual dining chain continues to expand its reach in 2026, with at least nine new restaurants arriving between April and June .
Now, another is being added to the ever-growing list in Carrollton, Georgia, located about 50 miles west of Atlanta, per the Times-Georgian .
In January, the Carrollton City Council approved a site plan amendment that will include the Texas Roadhouse .
Site plan details confirm a mixed-use layout, with the Texas Roadhouse attached to a residential apartment complex.
The amendment approval was unanimous, with Carrollton City council members like Bob Uglum noting that the restaurant will bring in more jobs and more income for the area.
“I think we will see a draw from a wide area that’s not just Carrolltonians eating at Texas Roadhouse,” Uglum told the outlet.
“There will be people from all over the county and east Alabama that will come here.”
“I hope it comes soon because I think it’d be a great asset to the community,” he added.
An opening date for the Texas Roadhouse has yet to be announced.
Given that the restaurant is part of the larger-scale mixed-use development plan, and that there is considerable infrastructure preparation required for a 330-unit apartment complex, it will not open before the end of 2026.
Another US city is even getting its second Texas Roadhouse soon as it works to accommodate thousands of hungry customers every week.
Diners in Moline, Illinois, located about 166 miles outside of Chicago, are getting the new location by May 2027.
It will be only five miles down the road from a 20-year-old Texas Roadhouse in the city of Davenport.
The Davenport Texas Roadhouse serves approximately 12,000 customers weekly, and Moline officials expect a similar experience.
“Well, butter our biscuits…the rumors are true!” the City of Moline posted on Facebook.
“Texas Roadhouse is coming to Moline!”
“The approximately $8 million restaurant will seat 360 guests and is expected to bring about 300 jobs to Moline,” the post noted.
By the end of 2026, Texas Roadhouse expected to open at least 35 company-owned locations across its three brands.
Along with the flagship, Texas Roadhouse Inc operates Bubba’s 33, a family-friendly sports bar, and Jaggers, a fast-casual chain known for hand-breaded chicken tenders and burgers.
By the end of Texas Roadhouse’s fiscal third quarter on September 29, at least six new flagship locations will have opened, according to comments from CEO Jerry Morgan during a recent earnings call.
Jaggers is even opening a brand-new restaurant in just weeks after amid a process that’s been “a couple years in the making.”
A Texas Roadhouse manager also recently revealed a cost-saving “$7 cut-off” trick shoppers can use at Costco or Sam’s Club.
